title: Algueron - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Algueron in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Algueron is a ice-element weapon used by Sciel. It scales with Vitality (B), Luck (C).

sections.title: How to Get the Algueron
sections.content:
Location: Old Lumiere - merchant Mendelyo.

Obtained from Old Lumiere - merchant Mendelyo.

sections.title: Is the Algueron Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Vitality (B), Luck (C). A dedicated ice pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
